Des signes d’incarnation de poil recourbé ont été observés dans 27,9 % des cas. Chez les hommes, les sites les plus affectés étaient la région sousmandibulaire (69,8 %), la région mandibulaire (52,1 %) et la face antérieure du cou (46,3 %). panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 2 panels (A, B). A: Real human-patient clinical photograph. Caption describes a hyperpigmented plaque with follicular papules in a left-sided beard distribution, and the disease-focused article title frames the lesion as pseudofolliculitis barbae. Findings map to beard-distribution papules and post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation; reported hypertrichosis is absent from the vocabulary and listed as proposed. Presentation (plaque with hypertrichosis) is a less common form, hence variant. B: Real human-patient close-up clinical photograph of the same beard-area lesion, with the biopsy site demarcated in blue ink (annotation). The corresponding lesion is the hyperpigmented plaque with follicular papules described for panel A, attributed to pseudofolliculitis barbae per the article framing; papules and hyperpigmentation are visible on close inspection.

panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 2 panels (A, B). A: Real patient H&E skin histology (low power) from the article whose title is disease-focused on pseudofolliculitis barbae ('Becker nevus presenting as pseudofolliculitis barbae'); not third-party. Caption/in-text describe a beard-area lesion with perifollicular fibrosis, increased hair follicles, acanthosis and rete-ridge tabling in a case presenting as pseudofolliculitis barbae. Tagged to pseudofolliculitis_barbae via the disease-focused title plus the captioned follicular/perifollicular manifestation. Findings are limited because the dominant histologic features (smooth muscle hamartoma, basal pigmentation) belong to the Becker-nevus spectrum and are not in the allowed vocabulary, so they are listed as proposed_findings; confidence is moderate. Age 15 (adolescent) from in-text. Skin tone not assessable on a histologic section. B: Real patient H&E skin histology (closer view) from the same pseudofolliculitis_barbae-presenting case; not...
